name: Northwind Health (fictional example client)
notes: Fictional client used to show a strict policy: web search is restricted to regulators and peer-reviewed journals, and the client supplies facts about its own product that are not on the public web.

pinned_facts.title: Northwind Triage app regulatory status
pinned_facts.content: Northwind Triage is a symptom-information app. It is not an FDA-cleared or FDA-approved medical device and does not diagnose. It tells users which level of care to consider and always advises contacting a clinician for urgent symptoms.

pinned_facts.title: Northwind Scribe deployment figures
pinned_facts.content: Northwind Scribe, the company's ambient clinical documentation assistant, was in use at 140 clinics as of June 2026. Clinicians review and sign every note it drafts.
